user.title: Bitzer Smart Connect
user.description: Sign in with your Bitzer Smart Connect account. Automatic tries web login, then mobile login if needed. Select a forced mode to use only that method.

device.title: Select a device
device.description: Pick the device to add. If the list is empty, enter the device ID — the number after /configurations/ in the web app URL.

data_description.device_name: Optional. A friendly name for this device in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in with your Bitzer Smart Connect account. Automatic tries web login, then mobile login if needed. Select a forced mode to use only that method.

reconfigure.title: Change connection settings
reconfigure.description: Sign in with your Bitzer Smart Connect account. Automatic tries web login, then mobile login if needed. Select a forced mode to use only that method.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Bitzer Smart Connect.

init.title: Bitzer Smart Connect options
init.description: Interval for the reconcile poll that runs alongside the live push connection.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to reconcile in the background. The live connection still delivers updates immediately when it's up.
data_description.expose_all: Also create entities for every configuration parameter the controller exposes (thresholds, schedules, program). They are created disabled — enable individually as needed. Off by default keeps the view to the live readouts and controls.
data_description.temp_min: Leave blank to use the product profile or the controller's own range. Override if your unit's real limits differ.
data_description.temp_max: Leave blank to use the product profile or the controller's own range.
data_description.fan_min: Lowest selectable fan step (e.g. 1). Blank = auto.
data_description.fan_max: Highest selectable fan step (e.g. 3). Blank = auto.
